context: Sho and Hina look at autumn clouds.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、雲、見て、本当、綺麗。
lines.en: Sho, look at the clouds — they're so beautiful!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick breath before the exclamation. Genuine childish wonder, no performance. Soft warmth throughout, like she's sharing something precious and wants him to see it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Small genuine laugh underneath. Speaking from real observation, not echoing. Soft, warm tone. The contentment of noticing the same thing as someone he likes.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: The sky is really wide, isn't it?
lines.style: Wondering tone. Opens with a soft lift of awe. Slower pace here — lingering on the bigness. Ends gently with the particle, inviting him into the moment rather than demanding response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Looking together makes it more fun.
lines.style: Small, certain voice. Not performative. A statement of simple fact that carries real feeling. Warm, steady. The kind of thing a quiet child says when he's noticed something matters.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft peak of brightness. Sincere without being loud. A child's full, uncomplicated joy — warm and trusting. Slight trailing softness, like the happiness is settling into her.
